verdict.rationale: Visa explicitly published an official MCP Server for Visa Intelligent Commerce APIs, with dedicated announcement and docs pages, plus a GitHub agent-toolkit repo confirming MCP server access alongside Vercel AI SDK support. This is well-documented first-party evidence of official MCP server connectivity for agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation the MCP server works in practice, and clarity on production maturity (one docs page notes the broader IC product is still 'in the process of development and deployment').
